method: Independent numpy shortest-arc Rodrigues calibration from actual rest child-head direction to C*source neutral parent rotation*+X; compare imported child-head direction and D_source*calibration to source phase quarters.

visual_review.observations: Both quarter-cycle front/profile sets retain a clean jaw. Forearms alternate in coherent opposite phases, with no gross flip or visible opening in these poses. Existing asymmetrical arm lengths and point-cloud compression remain. Full-cycle self-intersection was not exhaustively measured.

limits: Quarter source-axis agreement verifies actual child-head directions and explicit retarget formula; target limb lengths, segment offsets, shoes and inferred model proportions remain different from source.
No geometric continuous collision/intersection proof or planar stance proof is made.
Skin point-cloud extent ratios are not mesh volume; mixed upper-arm influences still compress about11% in fast motion.
Foot and Head axis calibration remain intentionally identity; Foot-to-ToeBase direction is not a source anatomical+X axis.
